camel_example: aliyun ossutil api post-vod-playlist --bucket examplebucket --playlist playlist.m3u8 --channel examplechannel --region cn-hangzhou --start-time 1636600271 --end-time 1636618271
description_en: Generates a Video on Demand (VOD) playlist for a specified LiveChannel
description_zh: 为指定的LiveChannel生成一个点播用的播放列表
name: PostVodPlaylist

parameters.help_en: The LiveChannel name. The LiveChannel must exist
parameters.name: channel

parameters.help_en: The name of the generated VOD playlist. The name must end with ".m3u8"
parameters.help_zh: 指定生成的点播播放列表的名称，必须以“.m3u8”结尾
parameters.name: playlist

parameters.help_en:
The end time for querying ts files.

Format: UNIX timestamp.
EndTime must be greater than StartTime, and the time span cannot exceed one day
parameters.help_zh:
指定查询ts文件的终止时间。
格式：Unix timestamp
EndTime必须大于StartTime，且时间跨度不能大于1天
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The start time for querying ts files. Format: UNIX timestamp
parameters.help_zh: 指定查询ts文件的起始时间，格式为Unix timestamp
parameters.name: start_time
